debut.label: The Holiday Epics
debut.heading: 1996–2007: The Winter Sanctuary
debut.description: The symphonic rock catalog of The Arctic Symphony Project, transforming orchestral holiday epics into an unyielding beacon of survival, family, and homecoming.

albums.title: A Symphony of Snow
albums.description: A sweeping symphonic rock Christmas album featuring the homecoming anthem 'Homeward on This Day'.

albums.title: Tales from the Solstice
albums.description: A 3-disc symphonic rock opera chronicling the harrowing 1996 abduction of Julian Rowlands and the auditory fortress his family built to guide him home, featuring both the English (United States) studio master and the 5-minute Trilingual 'Family Mix' (English US / French Québécois / Cymraeg) of 'Upon This Winter's Night'.
